cache_invalidation_rules: invalidate cached informants when the kernel signature changes
invalidate lens state when a lens switch occurs
invalidate packaging state when a packaging switch occurs
notes: The substrate is a continuous kernel/operator state rather than a finite map list.
P5 is causal only if its selected packaging changes P1 rewrite targeting and P2 gating targeting.

primitive_roles.P1: kernel rewrite driven by packaging and lens
primitive_roles.P2: gating of kernel viability and support
primitive_roles.P6: budget / income / cost control and stochastic temperature

budget_rules: income increases with packaging score, lens score, and stability
cost increases with phase and switching pressure
budget modulates the stochastic temperature for primitive selection
